p: heavens: Because men were obstinate and insensible, he calls to the dumb creatures, who were more prompt to obey God's word, as in De 32:1.
children: He declares his great mercy toward the Jews as he chose them above all other nations to be his people and children as in De 10:15.
ox knoweth his owner: The most dull and brute beasts acknowledge their duty more toward their masters, than my people do toward me, of whom they have received benefits without comparison.
seed of evildoers: They were not only wicked as were their fathers, but utterly corrupt and by their evil example infected others.
Holy One of Israel to anger: That is, him that sanctifies Israel.
stricken any more: What good is it to seek to mend you by punishment, seeing that the more I correct you, the more you rebel?
head is sick: By naming the chief parts of the body, he signifies that there was no part of the whole body of the Jews free from his rods.
sole of the foot even to: Every part of the body, the least as well as the chiefest was plagued.
neither bound up: Their plagues were so grievous that they were incurable, and yet they would not repent.
foreigners: Meaning, of them who dwell far off, who because they look for no advantage of that which remains destroy all before them.
Zion is left as a booth: That is, Jerusalem.
had left to us a very: Because he will always have a Church to call on his Name.
as Sodom: That is, all destroyed.
rulers of Sodom: You who for your vices deserved to be destroyed, as they of Sodom, save that God from his mercy reserved a little number, La 3:22.

delight not in the blood of: Although God commanded these sacrifices for a time, as aids and exercises of their faith, yet because the people did not have faith or repentance, God detests them, Ps 50:13, Jer 6:20, Am 5:22, Mic 6:7.
Bring no more vain oblations: Without faith and repentance.

new moons and your appointed feasts: Your sacrifices offered in the new moons and feasts: he condemns by this hypocrites who think to please God with ceremonies and they themselves are void of faith and mercy.
of blood: He shows that where men are given to evil, deceit, cruelty and extortion, which is meant by blood, there God will show his anger and not accept them though they seem holy, as in Isa 59:3.
Wash ye: By this outward washing, he means the spiritual: exhorting the Jews to repent and amend their lives.

do well: This kind of reasoning by the second table, the scriptures use in many places against the hypocrites who pretend holiness and religion in word, but when charity and love for their brethren should appear they declare that they have neither faith nor religion.
and let us reason together: To know if I accuse you without cause.
white as snow: Lest sinners should pretend any rigour on God's part, he only wills them to be pure in heart, and he will forgive all their sins, no matter how many or great.
are willing and obedient: He shows that whatever adversity man endures, it ought to be attributed to his own incredulity and disobedience.
faithful city become an harlot: That is, Jerusalem, which had promised happiness to me, as a wife to her husband.
murderers: Given to covetousness and extortion, which he signified before by blood, Isa 1:15.
silver is become dross: Whatever was pure in you before, is now corrupt, though you have an outward show.
thieves: That is, they maintain the wicked and the extortioners: and not only do not punish them, but are themselves such.

mighty One of Israel: When God will show himself merciful to his Church, he calls himself the Holy one of Israel, but when he has to do with his enemies, he is called Mighty, as against whom no power is able to resist.
rid myself of my adversaries: I will take vengeance of my adversaries the Jews and so satisfy my desire by punishing them.
and take away all thy tin: Lest the faithful among them should be overcome with his threatening he adds this consolation.
And I will restore thy judges: It is once the work of God to purify the heart of man, which he does because of his promise, made concerning the salvation of his Church.
judgment: By justice is meant God's faithful promise, which is the reason for the deliverance of his Church.
destruction of the transgressors and of: The wicked will not be partakers of God's promise, Ps 92:9.
oaks which ye have desired: That is, the trees and pleasant places where you commit idolatry which was forbidden De 16:22.
wick: The false god's in which you put your confidence will be consumed as easily as a piece of wick.
